dataset: Turkish hair transplant clinics, verified against primary sources
description: Every clinic we list, with the two facts the industry does not publish: whether the clinic names the surgeon who operates, and whether it puts a price in writing.
how_to_read: surgeon.state is one of four values and they are NOT interchangeable. `named` = the clinic names a physician on its own website. `checked_names_nobody` = we read the clinic's own website on the date in checked_on and it named no physician. `not_checked` = we have not looked, or the site refused automated access, and we make NO claim either way. `agency_does_not_operate` = this entry is a booking agency, which by its own description does not perform surgery.
`not_checked` must never be read, republished or aggregated as though it meant the clinic hides anything. It means we do not know.
price.state `our_estimate` means the clinic does not publish rates and the figures are our approximation from comparable clinics — not a quote, and not the clinic's price.
Ratings and review counts are deliberately absent. We hold no review volume we can source, and publishing an unsourced rating in a dataset about provenance would be self-defeating.
Every claim here is an observation of a public page on a stated date. It is not an assessment of clinical quality, and nothing here is medical advice.
corrections: Facts changed, or we got something wrong? Tell us at https://comparehairtransplant.com/contact and we will re-check and re-publish. Named a surgeon since we looked? That is exactly the case we want to hear about.

FUE, FUT, DHI and Sapphire, plus scarring-alopecia and repair work.
